The '''Shan family''' was a famous [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] family of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], including [[Bastila Shan]], her parents, [[Helena Shan]] and her [[Bastila Shan's father|husband]], and her descendants, including [[Satele Shan]] and her son [[Theron Shan|Theron]].

==History==
[[Helena Shan|Helena]] and her [[Bastila Shan's father|husband]] were [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]] from [[Talravin]]. They had one child, a daughter named [[Bastila Shan|Bastila]]. When she was a little girl, Bastila was found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Her mother, believing that treasure hunting was not the right life for her daughter, gave Bastila to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].
[[File:Vaner_Shan.png|thumb|left|Bastila Shan and her son, Vaner Shan]]
Bastila would play a major role in upcoming events. When the [[Jedi Civil War]] began, Bastila's skill in [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] would allow the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to escape certain defeat at the hands of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|the Sith Empire]] under the command of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Bastila eventually [[Capture of Darth Revan|captured]] Revan, who was redeemed from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Bastila and Revan were assigned by the [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Jedi Council]] to track down the [[Star Forge]]. During this time, Bastila and Revan fell in love. Bastila later turned to the dark side herself, but Revan redeemed her.<ref name="KOTOR" /> The two would play key roles in [[Battle of Rakata Prime|the final battle]] of the war, and eventually [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] before Revan's disappearance during his quest to stop the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|True Sith]]. Thereafter, their son, [[Vaner Shan]], fathered two children, [[Reesa Shan|Reesa]] and [[Bress Shan|Bress]].<ref name="Revan" />

Bastila Shan and Revan's descendants would eventually lead to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tasiele Shan]], who had a daughter named [[Satele Shan]] before her [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] by the Republic and the Jedi Order on account of her views on marriage and attachment.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Satele became a Jedi Knight and fought the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], and later became [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> She also had a son named [[Theron Shan|Theron]], who was the result of a secret six-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] affair with a [[Republic trooper]] named [[Jace Malcom]] in [[3667 BBY]].<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> Satele gave up Theron to the Jedi Order, though the boy lacked Force-sensitivity and later became an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]].<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 3: Uncertain Surrender]]'', Sith Lord [[Darth Baras]] states that he believes Satele is also a descendant of Revan, an affirmation that she neither denied nor confirmed.<ref name="Uncertain">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 3: Uncertain Surrender]]''</ref> Also, on Satele Shan's biography page on ''The Old Republic'' website, there is an [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] phrase that says "blood of Revan." Her kinship with Revan was later confirmed in ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.
